dataset.name: BUS-BRA
dataset.archive_verification: Fresh download matched pinned SHA-256 and publisher MD5 before preparation.
dataset.citation_reference: Gómez-Flores W, Gregorio-Calas MJ, Pereira WCA (2024). BUS-BRA: A Breast Ultrasound Dataset for Assessing Computer-aided Diagnosis Systems. Medical Physics 51:3110–3123. doi:10.1002/mp.16812.
dataset.licence: CC BY 4.0 in Zenodo; archive attribution licence also requires citation.
dataset.patient_mapping: released Case column, exact 1..1064, filename prefix agrees; publisher declares 1064 patients; both official CV folds keep Case together

release.change_scope: Server import guard only; canonical runner and all training, sampling, clipping and privacy settings unchanged.

prediction_numerics.policy: Retain the pushed prediction routes and numeric controls; identical checkpoint/transform and exact training tensor parity are verified. Test feature bitwise parity across the two prediction paths is not asserted.

split_policy.policy: Reuse byte-identical segmentation split JSON for each seed; split-v1 SHA256 patient ordering, first floor(n/5) patients held out, sites-v1 hash ordering dealt across three sites.
split_policy.split_source: Recreated by the unchanged segmentation prepare_busbra/split_subjects functions; require byte-identical archived hashes before execution.

declared_model.bounds_policy: Released image transform and fixed feature totalization; no data-derived feature bounds.
declared_model.head: linear 512 to 2; cross_entropy

protocol.data_route: dsImaging admission of image_root asset plus per-image metadata declaring pathology label, label levels and patient privacy unit; three DSLite custodians.

evaluation.aggregation: arithmetic mean and sample SD across three seeds
evaluation.alternative: None predeclared: this task specifies one cohort and one contract, with no named fallback. Report any epsilon-8 diagnostic failure without a post-score configuration change.
evaluation.central_schedule: Five rounds of one local epoch, batch 32, SGD 0.001, same initial head, patient-mean frozen features and patient-modal label, pooled Poisson sampling, expected batch divisor; no clipping or noise. Reuse this central fit across epsilon values for a seed.
evaluation.diagnostic: AUC > 0.5 and accuracy > held-out majority-class rate; report per-replicate and three-seed mean comparison.
evaluation.pooled_dp: Run unchanged released _dp_fit on the 852 pooled patient records, with the same five-round schedule and epsilon/delta/clip as federation.
evaluation.test_policy: Do not inspect held-out labels/images or score models before settings are fixed. One scoring pass for each trained replicate; never change a scored configuration.
twins: identical frozen backbone and head, same split and schedule, centrally without DP

protocol.instrumentation: Public-only observer copies of the segmentation/sequence harness: seed/capture analyst initialization; observe node accountant inputs/steps and public tensor hashes after the mandatory runner integrity gate. No replacement of training, privacy calibration, clipping or sampling.

model.bounds_policy: Released image transform and fixed feature totalization; no data-derived feature bounds.
model.head: linear 512 to 2; cross_entropy

protocol.model_params_policy: Unchanged v0.5.0 registry defaults; no schedule search.
protocol.patient_training: Released runner averages frozen features within patient and takes deterministic modal label before patient DP-SGD. Source pathology labels are consistent within patient according to archived audit.
protocol.randomness: Seed controls patient split and analyst-side public initial head. DP noise/sampling use unchanged node-owned sticky cryptographic randomness. Node secrets are not published; seed alone cannot reconstruct them.

limitations: Image-level evaluation; patient-level privacy and partitioning.
Central is the matched finite-schedule noiseless reference, not an optimized upper bound.
Prediction uses the pushed canonical and direct twin routes; test feature bitwise parity is not asserted. Runtime numerical controls are recorded in release.prediction_numerics.
Epsilon is per five-round training; no campaign-wide composition claim across repeated public-cohort fits.
Three seeds; DP randomness additionally depends on node-owned secrets.

scoring.scope: Single foreground scoring process; three independent canonical epsilon predictions concurrently per seed; direct twin features and metrics included.

campaign_wall_clock.note: Actual wall time; concurrent scoring durations are not summed. Central fits are reused across epsilons. Packaging and git delivery follow scoring.

diagnostic_roundoff_note: The unassessed seed 20260921 raw diagnostic is true because accuracy 0.6494565217391305 exceeds the floating majority rate 0.6494565217391304 by rounding. Accuracy ties the majority baseline. Raw scores are retained; this does not affect the predeclared epsilon-8 annotation.
